name: Boostnote
description: Boostnote uses electron-gh-releases with a BoostIO release repository and downloads/installs updates on packaged non-Linux builds after confirmation. The source review supports a Squirrel-era updater flow and signing-related build controls, but does not establish the claimed Windows SHA1 RELEASES-only or macOS Developer-ID details.
limitations: Newly retrieved default-branch snapshot, not the original study checkout; historical release behavior is not reverified.

The app delegates package format and cryptographic verification details to electron-gh-releases/Squirrel-era tooling; exact SHA1 and Developer-ID release settings are not shown in the reviewed implementation.
